name: claude-annotate
description: Draw on your running localhost site and send the marks straight into the Claude Code session that opened it.

plugins.name: annotate
plugins.description: /annotate <url> opens the page with drawing and note tools. Send to Claude pushes screenshots, notes and element context into this session; progress shows up on the page.

plugins.name: annotations
plugins.description: A Claude Code pane that lists this session's browser annotations and lets you send, delete or clear them. Needs the annotate plugin.
